## Summary

I've successfully added time-based sorting for meetings (פגישה) in the calendar app. The changes were made in two key locations:

1. **Entity List Screen** (`gen_app_calendar_ent1.dart`): Added sorting that organizes all meetings by time (שעה) in all views (list, board, calendar, table)

2. **Home Screen** (`gen_app_calendar_home.dart`): Enhanced the existing sort to use time as a secondary sort key when meetings fall on the same date

Both changes preserve existing functionality while ensuring meetings are always ordered chronologically by time within each date. Time values are compared as strings in HH:MM format, which produces correct chronological ordering. Empty/missing times are handled safely by sorting last.

A report has been written to `_report.md` with full details of the implementation and verification.
